main_text.l: TVBA Dei, I Thess. 4.16. tuba extrema in seculi consumma-tione, Matth. 24.31. I Cor. 15.52. tubæ argenteæ, Num. 10.2. Tubarum festum, V. SOLENNITAS.
[Tubas hominis in bello, in diebus, lætiæ, festi, promulgationis cuiuscunque priuatæ vel publicæ Tubæ cælestes Apoc. 18.22. Turbarum vsum V. Rum. 10. v. 1. ad 11. vsque

TVMVLTVS noxius. Exempla: Iudæi, Act. 7.57. milites, 12.18. Vide SEDITIO [tumultus castrensis, 1. Sam. 4.14. & 14.19. Tumultus petulantium, Exod. 32,17. Amos 5.23. Tumultus populi Matth. 26.5. & 27.24. Act. 20.1. & 21.38. & 24.18.]
TVNICA Aaron, Exod. 28.4. Christi, Ioan. 19.23. Psal. 22.19. [tunicæ Apostol. Act. 14.14. & 16.22. Tunicæ paupe-rum, Act. 9.39. Tunica legalis, & Christiana, Iud. v. 23.]

[TVRBAT Deus suos hostes, Iob. 13.11. Psal. 83.16. turbat cælum & mare, Esai. 13,13. Ierem 31.35. turbatur Christus, Ioan. 11.33. & 12.27. & 13.21. turbant & turbantur homines aliæque creaturæ, variis modis, Gen. 34.30. Iosh. 7.25. Iudic. 7.21. 1 Sam. 14.29. Iob 34.20 Psal. 6.4. & 46. v. 3 4. & 90.7. & 104.29. Prou. 25.26. Matt. 2.3. Luc. 1. v. 12.29. Ioan. 5. & 14. v. 1.27. Act. 15.24. & 17.13. & 20.10.]
TVRBATOR terræ, Achab, 1 Reg. 18.17. turbatores ordinis publici admonentur, 2 Thess. 3. v. 6. 11.12. 1 Thess. 5.14.
TVRPILOQVIVM abiiciendum, Eph. 5.4. Colos. 3.8. V. Sermo.
TVRPITVDO seu nuditas non detegenda: Leu. 18.6. &c. Quorum nam detegatur: Isa. 47.3. Apoc. 6.15.
[TVRRIS materialis, manu hominum constructa, Gen. 11. v. 4.5. Luc 13.4. Turris mystica, Psal. 61.4. Prou. 18.10.]
TYCHICVS, fidus Christi minister, Eph. 6.21. Col. 4.7. commendatur, Ibid. Ephesum mittitur, à Paulo ab urbe Roma 2. Tim. 4.12. (i. contingens.)
TYMPANIS celebrant Deum mulieres, Exo. 15.20. Iud. 11.34. Psal. 6.8. 26.1 Sam. 18.16. Vsus, Psal. 81.3. & 150.4. Abusus, Isa. 5.12. & 24.80.
TYRANNI schola, in qua Paulus differit, Act. 19.8.9.

TYRANNVS Tyranni imago, Prou. 28.15. tyrranni, Dei voluntate præsunt, Ierem. 27.8. tyranni arguuntur, Psal. 14.4. tyranni metui volunt, Esa. 10.13. aliquando subditos timent, Matt. 14.5. tyrannorum furorem fugere licet, Exod. 2.15. tyrannorum merces, Esa. 33.1. V. Iob. 15.20.
